apps.localizedDescription: A network listening post and payload instrument for iOS: BLE ears, a send/serve mouth, EMCON, Knocktalk — and Skelli, the onboard intelligence who runs it all with you.
apps.name: nightjar-hack
apps.versionDescription: 8.0b — the vanishing. A new boot film that plays once with the whole boot ceremony timed to it; Skelli taught in 59 new manual batches, presuming stealth unless told loud; Vanish, her emergency stop to full stealth; resume everywhere; her macro ears fixed; a haptic language and a process board that reports every running system from any screen. Carries 8.0a's Macros and the 7.7.7 whetstone sweep.
